conclusion: The Native Guest transition mismatch is not demonstrated in the inspected Heart adapter or ordinary Heart members route. No Heart source follow-up is proposed by this finite check.

coreFindings.subject: Actual Heart adapter
coreFindings.detail: The adapter conforms to PinkhaSpaceSharingService. readSnapshot admits active same-Space state and derives editable identities from active, nonself participants satisfying the original space.canChangeRole(target:). Owner grants Reader/Writer/Admin; Admin grants Reader/Writer; other actors grant nothing. The constructor supplies no per-member role map.

coreFindings.subject: Existing target eligibility
coreFindings.detail: canChangeRole rejects an Owner target; Owner can change other targets, Admin can change Reader/Writer targets only, and other actors cannot change roles. The adapter separately excludes self and inactive participants. Its removable set remains separate and uses existing canRemove, which excludes Owner/self and prevents an Admin from removing another Admin.

coreFindings.subject: Exact Heart role vocabulary
coreFindings.detail: The actual generated Heart protobuf enum declares Reader=0, Writer=1, Owner=2, NoPermissions=3 and Admin=4, plus UNRECOGNIZED(Int). It has no Guest enum case. ParticipantPermissions aliases this enum. The adapter maps NoPermissions/UNRECOGNIZED to shared .none, and nativeRole accepts only Reader/Writer/Admin; Guest is rejected before a role-change RPC.

coreFindings.subject: Real role-change backend call
coreFindings.detail: HeartSpaceSharingService.apply first reads a current snapshot, calls mutation.validate(in:), checks the account, and invokes WorkspaceService.participantPermissionsChange. That original service sends ClientCommands.spaceParticipantPermissionsChange with the scoped spaceID and one Anytype_Model_ParticipantPermissionChange(identity, perms). The adapter checks the account again and reads a resulting snapshot. No Native HTTP role mapping is substituted.

coreFindings.subject: Scope of the negative result
coreFindings.detail: The Heart client/adapter cannot issue the Native Guest upgrades, Writer/Admin-to-Guest, or Reader-to-Guest transitions through this inspected API. This does not establish an additional Heart Guest feature or a backend server authorization result. Native any-sync 5d71 semantics were not assumed to govern Heart.

ordinaryRoute.observation: This exact Settings-to-Members route uses the original SpaceShareView/model, not a newly inferred PinkhaSharing host adoption. Its menu is target-aware through canShowRoleMenu/canChangeRole/canPromoteToAdmin and existing plan-limit gates, and offers Admin (Owner actor only), Writer, Reader and removal; there is no Guest choice.
ordinaryRoute.limit: The adapter's existence is proven, but all constructor call sites or other Heart entry points were not indexed. No global absence, global adoption or missing-integration defect is claimed.
